name: cslice-gtranslate
description: Add GTranslate language translation widget to .cslice-gtranslate-wrapper div, paragraph or icon block. Style and languages are configured under Settings > General.
author: Creative Slice

scripts.plugin-zip: wp-scripts plugin-zip && NAME=$(jq -r .name package.json) && VERSION=$(grep 'Version:' $NAME.php | sed 's/.*Version: *\([^ ]*\).*/\1/') && mv $NAME.zip $NAME-$VERSION.zip
scripts.release: npm run format && npm run build && npm run plugin-zip
